title: Harada chart
description: One Harada chart. The root box is the center; every box can hold up to eight boxes, to any depth. See ../SKILL.md.

title.description: The chart's name: the page title and heading.

lede.description: One or two sentences under the heading on how to read the chart.

footer.description: Where the chart was built from.

labels.description: Words the page uses. All optional.

center.description: Name for the center box. Default: The goal.

centerNote.description: Heading over the center's note. Default: What it is for.

source.description: Short label before a source key in a cell, e.g. Ch. Default: Ch.

sourceName.description: Long label for a source, e.g. Chapter. Default: Chapter.

lede.description: Fallback lede if the chart has none.

statuses.description: Optional display names for the four statuses.

loose.description: Items that belong to the work but not yet to a box.

status.description: paid: it's there. thin: there but light. open: left open on purpose. author: needs the owner.

id.description: Root is g; its kids p1..p8; below, parent id plus -1..-8.

title.description: A statement of what the box does for the box above. Under about ten words.

kind.description: Set on actors, who open into the eight facets.

ch.description: Source key the quote comes from: the first number in the source file's name, or its name without the extension.

quote.description: Exact words from the source. Checked by the script.

note.description: How this box gets to the box above. Required in practice when the box has kids.

proposed.description: Candidate wording not yet in the source. Never a quote; status should be author.
